about: Gundrak ranged standoff on the Gal'darah causeway. Three Drakkari Raiders (29982) dismount from the stampede rhino (127207) and hold every party member combat-flagged from 16-26yd without ever closing. In tr-20260830-195435-2 and -6 the tank ping-ponged 27-47yd from Gal'darah for 29 minutes. The assist pickers read only getAttackers()/GetVictim(), so the leader-assist groupmate fallback claimed the tick and nobody engaged. The raiders have NO creature row (they are rhino vehicle accessories that SmartAI ejects at waypoint 3 of path 1272070), so they are staged as synthetics at that ejection point (summoned at the 1s injection, not at staging: in lr-20261003-155828-1-60 the staging-time summons went into combat during the settle, chased off the causeway to z 108.7 and never re-engaged), 25yd behind the bridge-teleport landing where the party starts. They are aggroed onto the party and rooted to model the parked holders. The rhinos are not kept. Fixed in d7689d58 (S2149): CollectCombatHolders unions PvE combat refs, so the tank is handed the raiders.
